---
title: "Clean_and_Filter_data"
format: html
---

## Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Read and load data

```{r}
FF_genome_raw <- read.table('../../../Big_data/FlyingFlies_SNPtable.txt', header = T)

# Note: frequency here refers to Reference allele frequency. If freq is low, then alternate allele frequency is high. 

```

## Plot Coverage Depth

```{r}
Coverage <- FF_genome_raw %>% select(contains("N_")) %>% pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Coverage") %>% mutate(Log_Coverage = log10(Coverage))

ggplot(data = Coverage) + geom_boxplot(aes(Sample, Log_Coverage))

Mean_Coverage <- Coverage %>% group_by(Sample) %>% summarise(m_log_cover = mean(Log_Coverage))
```

### Filter Trials

#### Coverage Filter

```{r}
filt_cover <- Coverage %>% filter(Coverage >= 30)

ggplot(data = filt_cover) + geom_boxplot(aes(Sample, Log_Coverage))
```

#### Frequency filter

```{r}
allele_freq <- FF_genome_raw %>% select(CHROM, POS, contains("freq_")) %>% pivot_longer(cols = starts_with('freq_'), names_to = "population", values_to = "alle_freq") %>% mutate(Chromosome = as.factor(CHROM))

# ggplot(data = allele_freq) + geom_boxplot(aes(population, alle_freq))
```
